pages.text: $(l)$(2)Magical Botany$()$(br2)Botanists might find that some plants have magical properties. They might find that other, related things might $(o)also$() contain this same magical property, Aura, which can be utilized for many things such as:$(li)The production of materials.$(li)The creation of new ideas$(li)The harnessing of the world$(br)   itself!
